blocks.text: The Tetris game is an iconic puzzle game that has been enjoyed by millions of people around the world for nearly 40 years. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Tetris is a great way to challenge your brain and sharpenyour reflexes. The Tetris game is a game that can be enjoyed by people of all ages. Whether you're a child or a grandparent, you're sure to have a blast playing Tetris. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore competitor, etris is a game that you'll never get tired of!

items.label: Officialy Licensed
items.value: This is an officially licensed Tetris title, ensuring an authentic gaming experience. Includes 200 bonus games!!!

items.label: 🕹️ Addictive Gameplay
items.value: The iconic Tetris game challenges your brain with addictive puzzle action, fast-paced block stacking and sharpens your reflexes. Full color 2.5" screen

items.label: Vibrant Art Style
items.value: Enjoy the charming and colorful visuals that have become a hallmark of Tetris, appealing to players of all ages. Intuitive user interface. Built-in speaker with volume control

items.label: 🎯 Portable Power
items.value: Requires 3 AAA non-rechargeable batteries for gaming on-the-go (batteries not included) or by a USB Type C cable (not included). Mini Screwdriver needed and not included.

items.label: Headphone Jack
items.value: 3.5mm headphone jack lets you enjoy Tetris on the go on your own privately. Perfect for travel. Take your games anywhere

items.label: 🎁 Great Gift
items.value: Makes an excellent birthday or holiday gift for kids and adults. Dimensions: 4.80"W x 2.50"H x 0.88"D

items.label: User Guide Languages
items.value: English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, German, Dutch, Japanese and Arabic.

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Improve cognitive skills and problem-solving abilities

items.label: Item Dimensions L X W X H
